Complete employee HR records: names, dates of birth, home addresses, phone numbers, personal and corporate email addresses, CURP, RFC, IMSS numbers, salaries and employee badge photographs.Payroll records, tax data, fiscal validation files and HSBC payroll-bank files containing employee account and CLABE data.Information showing executive compensation through an **honorarios** arrangement outside the regular payroll system.Financial and industrial reports, sales/procurement/payroll budgets, production costs, operational analytics, invoices and accounting records.Customer complaint records and overdue receivables data.Occupational-safety, psychosocial-risk, industrial-incident and hazardous-waste documentation.
